ecosystem_regime.interpretation: Spot DEX velocity has accelerated much faster than perpetual volume and 24-hour inflow remains positive, but retained stablecoin growth has faded to only +0.35% over seven days. The headline DEX acceleration therefore does not yet establish broad discretionary-capital migration.

wallet_migration_contamination.event: Phantom ends Sui network support on 2026-09-24.
wallet_migration_contamination.mechanical_flow: Phantom is waiving its fee through the transition date for cross-chain swaps from native SUI to wrapped SUI on Solana and is directing users either to migrate their wallet to a Sui-compatible wallet or swap into assets that remain supported in Phantom.
wallet_migration_contamination.framework_treatment: Discount recent Sui DEX, transfer, bridge and wallet-migration activity to the extent it can be explained by the forced wallet transition. The migration mechanism can create real executed volume without representing fresh discretionary speculation.

rwa_treatment: $37M of RWA Active AUM is issuance/inventory. No fresh Sui-specific secondary-trading or collateral-utilization acceleration was verified in this run, so no RWA-usage credit is awarded.
wallet_quality: No new cohort of historically selective, independently funded wallets repeatedly accumulating SUI was verified. Broad exchange buyer ratios and raw address growth are not substitutes for that test.

structural_gate.notes: SUI is a native asset with an official 10B total-supply cap and a scheduled release curve. Honeypot, removable-LP and third-party token-admin freeze risks do not apply in the ordinary token-contract sense, but future scheduled supply release/dilution remains material.

portfolio_decision.rationale: The existing opening SUI position is retained because price persistence, positive 24-hour inflow and spot-over-perps acceleration have not invalidated the thesis. No add is justified after a roughly 49% seven-day token move because stablecoin retention is weak, Phantom's exit can mechanically contaminate activity metrics, and selective-wallet confirmation is absent. No trim is triggered because there is no hard structural failure or confirmed persistent capital flight yet.

forward_tests: After the September 24 Phantom cutoff, Sui DEX activity should remain elevated without the migration mechanic.
Stablecoin growth should reaccelerate and remain positive rather than follow users/assets out of the ecosystem.
Net inflows should remain positive after the wallet transition window.
Independent selective-wallet repeat accumulation should emerge before any paper add.
uncertainties: The Phantom transition cannot explain all Sui DEX activity, so the framework discounts rather than rejects the entire volume acceleration.
The exact share of recent swaps and transfers caused by Phantom migration is not observable from the public aggregate chain metrics used in this run.
Scheduled supply-release timing and size remain a dilution caveat but are not treated as a hard gate failure absent a new privileged-control or sellability problem.
